hypotheses.name: Rank-based multiparameter persistence surface
hypotheses.method: Across immune/lung/external_lung and seeds 42/43/44 on source/target-disjoint splits and layers {7,11}, transformed distance and support-margin axes to rank coordinates, built rank-bifiltration connectivity surfaces, and compared rank-surface scoring against directed baseline and one-axis ablation with axis-rank permutation and label-permutation controls.
hypotheses.result_value: mean delta AUROC=-0.03048 (std 0.01348); lung/source=-0.03243; external_lung/source=-0.03453; positive mean domain-splits 0/6
hypotheses.next_action: Retire this utility endpoint form for persistent-homology rank surfaces in this loop; reopen only with a materially changed endpoint (e.g., calibration/ranking objective rather than direct AUROC lift).
hypotheses.retirement_reason: Major-change rescue still failed all domain-split mean utility gates and did not recover source-disjoint failure slices.

hypotheses.name: Cycle-consistent utility-regularized cross-model mapping
hypotheses.method: Seed42 pilot on immune/lung/external_lung with source/target-disjoint splits at layers {7,11}; learned utility-weighted cycle-consistent GF<->scGPT maps on two held-in domains, then evaluated held-out-domain mapped transfer against GF baseline with random linear map, anchor-pair shuffle, and signature-destroy controls.
hypotheses.result_value: mean delta AUROC(transfer-baseline)=-0.30464; mean null_gap_q95=-0.03847; mean mapped-to-sc cosine=+0.00560; immune mean null_gap_q95=-0.10658; non-immune rows meeting (null_gap>0 and delta>=0): 0/8
hypotheses.next_action: Retire this cross-model utility-transfer endpoint for this loop; only revisit cross-model alignment with a fundamentally different representation objective tied directly to held-out utility gains.
hypotheses.retirement_reason: Major-change rescue failed both utility and null-gap criteria across immune and non-immune held-out evaluations.

hypotheses.name: Multiscale geodesic triangle-defect spectrum
hypotheses.method: Across immune/lung/external_lung and seeds 42/43/44 on source/target-disjoint splits and layers {7,11}, computed edge-level multiscale geodesic triangle-defect summaries at k={8,12,16} and tested incremental value over directed-geodesic baseline with endpoint-swap, matched-random-third-node, and label-permutation controls.
hypotheses.result_value: mean delta AUROC=+0.02617 (std 0.02707); positive rows 30/36; positive mean domain-splits 6/6; all domain-split means positive (immune/source +0.00162 to lung/target +0.05308)
hypotheses.next_action: Run one robustness expansion with higher null resolution (>=32 permutations/family) and seed-layer bootstrap CIs to test whether gains survive the matched-random-third null at row level.
